name: skill-radar
description: A local Electron desktop dashboard that scans and organizes Codex and Claude Code skills.
author: xiaou61

scripts.dist: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$proxy=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProxyServer; Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($proxy) { $env:HTTP_PROXY='http://'+$proxy; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://'+$proxy }; npx electron-builder --win nsis portable"
scripts.release: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$proxy=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProxyServer; Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($proxy) { $env:HTTP_PROXY='http://'+$proxy; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://'+$proxy }; npx electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish always"
